core.title: Callington Lever With Brookshire Rose, Schlage F-CLT-BRK
tags: Schlage f series Callington door Levers

text.description_html:
Schlage F-Series, Callington Door Lever Set With Ornate Brookshire Rose

The classic beauty of Schlage's Callington Lever with Brookshire Rose is a great way to add sophistication throughout your home. Easy to install, it fits standard door cutouts and has an adjustable backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4". It is adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" door thicknesses. Ornate yet elegant, this leverset is available in passage, privacy, dummy, or keyed entry functions.

When you install Schlage lever, you safeguard your home and family as well as your peace of mind. Schlage door levers are resistant to tarnishing, discoloration and corrosion. Plus, the wide variety of finishes may make your decision tough--just like this leverset.

Features of the Callington Door Lever:

  • One piece lever for better security and appearance.
  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • ANSI A156.2 series 4000 grade 2 keyed entry function.
  • Pressure-cast zinc tubular lock housing.
  • Lifetime mechanical warranty on residential applications.
  • Solid brass lever and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the F-Series Callington Schlage Door Levers Brookshire Collection:

  • Lever Length: 4-1/2"
  • Rose Height: 4-13/64" (4.2")
  • Rose Width: 2-15/16" (2.92")
  • Adjustable Backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" thick doors
  • Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" Round Corner (1/4" radius corners)
  • Throw: 1/2"
  • Strike Plate: 1-5/8" x 2-1/4" Round Corner Full Lip Strike Plate

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on one side of the door. It does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. The lock is activated by a push button in the center of the lever while turning the inside lever releases the lock. It can be opened from the outside with a small circular tool.
  • Keyed Entry (Keyed Lock): Use when a handle operated by a lock is needed. Unlocked by a key from the outside when locked by inside turn button. Inside always unlocked.
  • The Single Dummy Levers are Handed. Click Here to Determine Handing. All other Callington Lever functions are Non-Handed.
